title: Jim Cramer: Don't Buy Tech ETFs, Buy Strong Tech Stocks - RealMoney
text: Jim Cramer: Don't Buy Tech ETFs, Buy Strong Tech Stocks There are some solid individual names in tech, but traders must be selective. JIM CRAMER Dec 11, 2018 | 07:11 AM EST Stocks quotes in this article: FB , AAPL , GOOGL , AMZN , AMD , NVDA , CSCO , TECD , HPQ , AVGO , SPLK , WDAY , CRM , VMW , PANW , LRCX , AMAT Is there any reason in the world that tech should bottom? Does it make any sense at all, when we see Facebook's (FB) stock being poleaxed, Apple's (AAPL) stock getting crushed, Alphabet (GOOGL) being listless, jarred by its CEO's Congressional testimony and Amazon (AMZN) seemingly treading water despite great AWS results?
